name: Bungee Jumping
overview: Scripture uses imagery of leaping and jumping to illustrate both joyful restoration and perilous temptation. Isaiah 35:6 portrays a hopeful transformation where the lame will leap like a hart, symbolizing God's renewing power. Conversely, Matthew 4:5-7 warns against testing God’s protection through reckless daring, as Jesus rebukes the devil for urging Him to jump from the temple pinnacle. This tension reminds believers to trust God’s sovereignty without succumbing to presumption or spiritual danger.
